description: This file defines classes and functions related to Chrome's trust store, including data structures for root certificates and trust store management, with functions for creating, accessing, and verifying trust store contents.

classes.name: ChromeRootCertInfo
classes.description: Holds DER-encoded root certificate data as a span of bytes.

classes.name: ChromeRootStoreData
classes.description: Container class storing Chrome Root Store data, including anchors and version.

classes.name: TrustStoreChrome
classes.description: Manages Chrome's trust store, either from static data or provided anchors, and implements trust-related methods.

methods.name: CreateChromeRootStoreData
methods.description: Creates a ChromeRootStoreData object from a proto, returning nullopt if errors occur.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome::CreateTrustStoreForTesting
methods.description: Creates a TrustStoreChrome instance with custom certs for testing.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome::Contains
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is in the trust store.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome::version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Chrome Root Store.
